thread:
Ashley: Noticed another brief outage pattern — auth provider bursts -> model-registry read timeouts -> user-facing 503s on hosted endpoints. This is showing up in three different windows last month. We need ownership, a short-term mitigation, and a vendor SLA ask.
Morgan: Can we confirm recurrence cadence and whether it's regional?
Jordi: Quick summary from traces: spikes at ~02:40 UTC and ~16:10 UTC across us-west-2 and eu-central. Correlates with IdP rolling certs and a burst of refresh_token calls.
Priya: Short-term we can do two things: 1) client-side token cache with jittered refresh + small TTL, 2) registry read-only fallback using a service token for non-write operations. Both should be feature-flagged. Owners: sdk PRs -> @Priya, fallback -> @Cal. Target: PoC in 72h.
Cal: I'll spin up fallback token support behind a flag and add a basic verification endpoint. POC ETA: 72h. Acceptance: registry read during simulated IdP delay should succeed using fallback token in >98% of calls for 5m.
SRE-Lead: Creating tracking ticket INC-2026-4201 and assigning SRE oncall for coordination. I'll also own runbook edits and pager thresholds.
DevOps-Bot: Action created: ACTION-201 (idp-fallback-poc), ACTION-202 (auth-synthetic-check), ACTION-203 (sdk-jitter-prs), ACTION-204 (vendor-sla-engagement).
Morgan: I'll update the runbook to add the new synthetic probes and a clear rollback plan. ETA: 96h.
Jordi: For the synthetic probe, hit auth flow + model-registry read path and alert when error-rate > 2% over 3m or p95 latency > 400ms. Probe snippet: 
```
# synthetic: auth -> registry read
curl -s -X POST https://auth.prod.internal/refresh -d '{"client_id":"svc-synth"}' | jq -r '.token' | xargs -I {} curl -H "Authorization: Bearer {}" https://model-registry.prod.internal/v1/models/health
```
Output expected: 200 + {"status":"ok"}.
Priya: SDK changes: add auth.refresh_jitter config, default 0.2-0.5s, and auth.cache_ttl default 30s. Will open PRs for node and python, tag devex. ETA: 1 week.
Cal: We also need an inventory of which dedicated/private customers already use local caching. I'll own an inventory doc and reach out to solutions-eng for uptake. ETA: 5 days.
Legal-Bot: Flag: vendor contract mentions 99.9% auth availability but no explicit cascading-availability clause. Recommend @Ashley lead a vendor engagement to request explicit change-window commitments and an RCA for recent cert rollouts.
Ashley: I'll lead vendor outreach and ask for: (a) scheduled rollout windows, (b) option for staged cert rollouts per-region, (c) SLA amendment for auth availability or a runbook for certificate rollovers. ETA: 72h to initial contact.
SRE-Lead: Longer-term hardening: increment registry read retry backoff cap, add concurrency throttles at registry gateway, and evaluate per-region token relays. Owners: @Jordi (retries), @SRE-Lead (throttles), ETA: 2 weeks.
Morgan: Tracking board entries: ACTION-201 -> owner Cal (POC), ACTION-202 -> owner Morgan (synthetic), ACTION-203 -> Priya (SDK PRs), ACTION-204 -> Ashley (vendor outreach), ACTION-205 -> Jordi (retry/backoff). I'll add acceptance criteria and link to incident.
Priya: Acceptance criteria suggestions: fallback POC must demonstrate <1% increase in user-visible errors during a 5m injected 1s auth delay; synthetic probe must page SRE when registry read failure rate > 2% in 3m; vendor engagement must return a written plan or change-window commitment within 14 days.
Cal: Quick validation curl for fallback token (replace token):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_FALLBACK_TOKEN" https://model-registry.prod.internal/v1/models/health
```
Expect: 200 {"status":"ok","version":"..."}
Ashley: Let's sync cadence: short standup in 3 days and full follow-up next Tuesday 09:00 UTC. Keep updates in ACTION tickets; only escalate blockers in #eng-oncall.
SRE-Lead: Noted. Please update respective ACTION items before the 3-day check-in. We'll close out low-risk items quickly and escalate any vendor contract asks to legal/sales if needed.
Morgan: Thanks everyone. Short updates only in this thread please.
